spec.kitLine: Start of battle: Shield 40.12% Max HP
spec.assertion: A `shield` event targeting mori at frame<=1 with maxHpPct 40.12. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'encode shield as heal' (which emits recovery events and would drive teammates' on-recovery consumers) and under omission (no shield event, breaking any requiresShielded gate).

spec.kitLine: On Burst if NOT in Struggle: shield
spec.disposition: FAITHFUL (gate; inactive branch at scope lock)
spec.assertion: Exactly ONE shield event across the fight despite multiple mori burstCasts. Fails under an ungated burstCast re-shield (N+1 shield events). Non-vacuity: mori's burstCast count is asserted >0 in the same test.

Zero self Max-HP buffApply events with maxStacks 5. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'author as passive at max stacks', which would grant 25.3% Max HP from t=0 and feed any atkOfMaxHpPct consumer. Struggle never ends at scope lock (boss deals no damage; kit gives Struggle no timer).

mori's skill bucket is empty — the hitCount:60 cadence carries no damage/stat payload. Fails under repurposing the taunt trigger into a damage rider. Non-vacuity: mori's magazine is 60 and she reloads many times over 180s, so a 60-hit trigger genuinely fires.
No sustainedDamagePct buffApply with value 2.03. Fails under keying it to `passive`/`interval`, which would grant a permanent ~10.15% ally Sustained buff. Active case it.skip'd.

mori emits zero sustained-flavored / skill-bucket damage. Fails under the nearest-wrong `interval` or `passive` DoT encoding, which would add a free 23.23%/s tick for the whole fight (and, per taxonomy #5, MULTIPLY if a 15s duration rode a repeating trigger). Active case it.skip'd.

No recovery event sourced from mori. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'Recovers Shield HP == heal' reading, which would fire teammates' on-recovery consumers on every mori burst. Non-vacuity: mori is in Struggle all fight, so this IS the live branch.
No self Max-HP buffApply with value 10.09. Fails under dropping the not-in-Struggle gate, which would apply it on every burst. Mirror of the skill1b gate.

5 buffApply events per mori burstCast (all allies incl. self), each landing on a mori cast frame with a finite expiresFrame and no durationShots. Fails under (a) fullBurstEnter keying — applications land on fullBurstStart frames, over-firing on rotations mori sits out; (b) permanent duration — the durationSec-stripped counterfactual deals strictly more team damage; (c) generic attackDamagePct encoding — asserted absent, and stripping the line leaves mori's own total byte-identical, proving sustained-channel scoping.

fixtures: controlComp('mori', true) for every run — mori is Burst II, so the control's B1 (liter) and B3 slots are required for any burst to chain at all (a unit that cannot complete a chain casts nothing and every burst assertion goes vacuous). The fixed B3 (helm) is KEPT: all mori assertions are event-identity/count assertions (which slug, which frame, which stat, which value), not magnitude reads, so helm's buffs cannot confound them; the one totals-based assertion (permanent-duration counterfactual) is a strict A/B against the same fixture, so any helm contribution cancels. Three counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride, all hoisted: burst Sustained line removed (scope/inertness), Sustained re-keyed to fullBurstEnter (trigger identity), Sustained durationSec stripped (duration semantics). 4 runs total, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill2b (allies Sustained ▲2.03% x5 on part destruction) — it.skip: no part-destruction trigger kind exists in TriggerDef and the scope-lock boss is partless, so the active case is unreachable; only the inertness half is testable.

skill2c (23.23% of final ATK sustained DoT every 1s for 15s on the highest-ATK enemy, on part destruction) — it.skip: same missing trigger; additionally the 'highest-ATK enemy' target selection is degenerate against a single-target boss.

skill1c (Max HP ▲5.06%, 5 stacks, on Struggle end) — no it.skip written (covered by an inertness assertion instead): Struggle has no kit-stated timer and the boss deals no damage, so the shield is never broken and the trigger can never fire in v1. If a future engine models shield consumption, this becomes a live line.
burst-a (Recovers Shield HP 15.04% of final Max HP) — no shield HP pool is modeled, so the top-up is unobservable beyond asserting it is not a heal.
skill2a (Taunt 4 sec) — no taunt/aggro primitive; the sim models no incoming damage. Inertness-only.

⚑ NOT DERIVABLE FROM THE KIT: what ENDS Struggle status. The prose says the shield is created 'continuously' and gives no expiry, no HP threshold, and no timer — yet skill1c fires 'when Struggle status ends' and both the burst and skill1b branch on in/not-in Struggle, which only makes sense if it CAN end (presumably when the shield is depleted by boss damage). At scope lock the boss deals no damage, so every Struggle-end-dependent line is dead. Recipe: this is a defensive-mechanic question, unobservable in a solo-raid damage sim; it would need a fight where mori takes damage and her shield breaks. Flagged rather than guessed — inventing an expiry would fabricate up to 25.3% Max HP plus a 10.09% burst grant.
